skill.summary: Analyze TikTok content at scale — extract insights from videos, hashtags, music tracks, and live streams including engagement trends, comment sentiment, capt...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of keyapi-tiktok-content-analysis.
- Provides scalable TikTok content analysis: videos, hashtags, music, and live streams.
- Enables insights into engagement trends, comment sentiment, caption transcription, and commerce attribution.
- Supports robust analytic workflows using multiple Node.js tool endpoints.
- Requires a KEYAPI_TOKEN and Node.js v18+ for setup.
